post.title: Top 10 Free Apps For Dynamics 365 Business Central
post.content:
If you’re using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, you already know it’s a powerful ERP platform. But what if you could make it even better—without spending a single rupee? Here’s a curated list of 10 free apps available on Microsoft AppSource that will boost your Business Central performance, improve usability, and save time.

1. Use Dynamics

An in-app learning tool that provides embedded video guides directly within Business Central. Perfect for onboarding new users or training teams faster.

2. Excel Importer

Import bulk data from Excel or CSV files directly into Business Central without complex mappings or manual entry.

3. Continia Document Capture

Automates the capture, OCR, and processing of vendor invoices and documents. A great way to streamline your accounts payable process.

4. WMS Express by Insight Works

A free warehouse management solution for barcode scanning, ideal for businesses needing mobile inventory tools.

5. Bankfeed – Reconciliation

Automates bank statement imports and simplifies reconciliation within BC. Saves time and reduces manual errors.

6. Simple Object Designer

Add custom fields or tables in Business Central without writing code. A must-have for businesses with specific data needs.

7. Master Data Information

Helps manage and maintain master data across companies and databases. Great for large-scale operations.

8. Excel Report Builder

Create powerful and formatted Excel-based financial and operational reports directly within Business Central.

9. Barcode Generator

Add 1D and 2D barcodes to reports, labels, and documents. Useful for tracking and warehouse management.

10. Intercompany

Manage transactions and financial consolidation across multiple Business Central companies with ease.

Why These Free Apps Matter

These apps are designed to:

  • Increase productivity without additional investment

  • Eliminate manual processes

  • Improve accuracy

  • Customize your ERP system based on your business needs

Whether you’re managing finance, inventory, or operations, these tools can help you work smarter.

How to Install Them

  1. Open Business Central and use the Tell Me feature to search “Microsoft AppSource Apps.”

  2. Browse or search for the app name listed above.

  3. Click “View in AppSource” and install.

  4. Go to Extension Management to manage the app settings.
